statusDefinitions.partial: Implementation exists but has gaps or is not live-verified.
statusDefinitions.completed: Implemented; verification state specifies the confidence level.
statusDefinitions.blocked: Cannot proceed until an external decision or dependency is resolved.
statusDefinitions.rejected: Considered but decided not to implement.

tasks.title: Rotate and remove exposed credentials
tasks.summary: Deferred: this cluster does not currently use a secret manager.
tasks.blockedReason: No approved secret-management solution is available in the cluster.

tasks.title: Install Argo CD
tasks.summary: Legacy project notes report Argo CD as installed; governance Applications still need to be tracked.

tasks.title: Create LDAP UID and GID lookup container
tasks.summary: Legacy project notes report this container as created; image, deployment, and verification evidence must be located.

tasks.title: Configure and verify H100 MIG layout
tasks.summary: Verified live on kw01: H100-01 exposes two 3g.47gb instances and H100-02 exposes three 1g.12gb and two 2g.24gb instances; full GPUs are not allocatable.

nvidia-mig-manager and nvidia-device-plugin pods are Running on kw01

tasks.title: Use kubeflow-governance for namespace resource management
tasks.summary: User and project namespace resources are managed through the kubeflow-governance Helm chart and separate administrator scripts.

tasks.title: Document user NFS storage governance
tasks.summary: Each hpc-user namespace receives a dedicated 20Gi RWX NFS PV and PVC, mounted at /home/<username>/nfs; PVs use Retain reclaim policy. Project storage remains part of the separate project workflow.
verificationEvidence: hpc-user-test-doitnow has a Bound 20Gi RWX NFS PVC.

tasks.title: Provision Harbor projects and access controls
tasks.summary: Create Harbor projects, LDAP or Dex membership rules, robot accounts, and promotion controls.

tasks.title: Maintain base images and vulnerability promotion rules
tasks.summary: Custom notebook images are version-pinned and Trivy storage exists; define the hpc-base portfolio, scan policy, and promotion gate.

tasks.title: Configure Harbor retention policies
tasks.summary: Retain stable and promoted images while cleaning temporary and unused images.

tasks.title: Package LDAP SSSD configuration for user environments
tasks.summary: Create secure SSSD configuration with approved secret injection, logging, and no plaintext bind credentials.

tasks.title: Publish and verify LDAP UID/GID image
tasks.summary: Publish the LDAP UID/GID image to Harbor and verify UID, GID, and SSSD log behavior.

tasks.title: Apply governance ResourceQuotas
tasks.summary: User and project quota defaults are configured. Storage is temporarily set to 50Gi for testing so a 20Gi NFS PVC and a 10Gi NVMe workspace PVC can coexist.
verificationEvidence: hpc-user-test-doitnow ResourceQuota has requests.cpu=16, limits.cpu=32, requests.memory=64Gi, limits.memory=128Gi, persistentvolumeclaims=4, pods=10, and requests.storage=50Gi.
The active namespace has a Bound 20Gi NFS PVC and a Bound 10Gi longhorn-nvme-gpu workspace PVC.

tasks.title: Create approved project namespace workflow
tasks.summary: new-project.sh validates the owner and contributors in LDAP, then renders a Kubeflow Profile, quota, Kubeflow contributor RoleBindings, and contributor Istio AuthorizationPolicies for administrator review and Argo CD sync. The Profile syncs first so its namespace exists before namespaced contributor resources.
verificationEvidence: new-project.sh rendered Profile hpc-project-h117 with test-doitnow as owner and test2-doitnow as contributor.
The chart passed Helm lint after rendering the Profile, contributor RoleBinding, and contributor AuthorizationPolicy.
